definition: Period total fertility rate by the woman's self-reported level of religiosity, from the Israel Central Bureau of Statistics. Separate ladders for Jewish and Muslim women. The Jewish Ultra-Orthodox (Haredi) rate of 6.8 is the CBS religiosity estimate for 2022–24 — distinct from the religion-only table (Jewish / Muslim / Druze / Arab) and from the older Israel Democracy Institute Haredi estimate of 6.4 for 2020–2022. Southern-District exclusions remove Negev Bedouin from the Muslim comparison.
source: Israel Central Bureau of Statistics — Fertility of Jewish and Other Women in Israel by Level of Religiosity (2022–24)

excludingSouthern.note: Excludes the Southern District and removes Negev Bedouin.
